description.text: Generated by fixtures/accelerators/scrape.py from the official page retrieved on 2026-11-10. It repeats that page's visible text and adds nothing to it: Accelerace – Leading Pre-Seed Investor & Accelerator Investments Get funding Portfolio Transparency report Matchmaking Sidel Pilot Project 2025 For startups For corporates Stories About Accelerace Our story Partner programs Team Careers Presskit Contact Home of the Nordic founders building the great companies of tomorrow We are the leading pre-seed investor and startup accelerator in the Nordics This is Accelerace Since 2008, Accelerace has been the first stop for 2000+ parents, university students, c-level executives, first-timers, crazy people and everyone in-between that today lead some of Europe’s most promising startups and scaleups. Pre-seed funding We invest in Nordic and Baltic pre-seed stage startups and invite you to our lifelong founders community, Accelerace Allstars. Get funding Partner programmes We co-manage several accelerator and mentoring programmes around Europe for startups in different industries and stages. Get accelerated Corporate matchmaking We leverage our understanding of both startups and corporates, to find the perfect curated matches, that benefits everyone. Match now Accelerace allstars Pre-seed funding and support from top founders By becoming a portfolio company of Accelerace, you automatically become part of Accelerace Allstars. This is a lifelong community for founders in the Nordics and Baltics, where we help you prepare to raise seed No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
